text: 商务部服贸司负责人介绍2026年1-8月服务贸易发展情况，2026年1-8月，我国服务进出口总额50701.6亿元（人民币，下同），同比增长7.9%。其中，出口19996.1亿元，增长14.8%；进口30705.5亿元，增长3.8%。服务贸易逆差10709.4亿元，同比缩小1451.2亿元。知识密集型服务出口占比超过一半。1-8月，知识密集型服务进出口22314亿元，增长6.6%，占服务进出口总额的44%。知识密集型服务出口10744.7亿元，增长10.9%，占服务出口额的53.7%；其中，个人文化和娱乐服务、金融服务增长最快，增速分别为66%和21.6
text_en: The head of the Department of Trade in Services and Commercial Services of the Ministry of Commerce introduced the development of trade in services from January to August 2026. From January to August 2026, China's total trade in services imports and exports reached 5,070.16 billion yuan (RMB, same below), up 7.9% year on year. Among this, exports were 1,999.61 billion yuan, up 14.8%; imports were 3,070.55 billion yuan, up 3.8%. The trade in services deficit was 1,070.94 billion yuan, narrowing by 145.12 billion yuan year on year. Knowledge-intensive services accounted for more than half of service exports. From January to August, imports and exports of knowledge-intensive services totaled 2,231.4 billion yuan, up 6.6%, accounting for 44% of total trade in services imports and exports. Exports of knowledge-intensive services were 1,074.47 billion yuan, up 10.9%, accounting for 53.7% of service exports; among them, personal culture and entertainment services and financial services grew fastest, with growth rates of 66% and 21.6%, respectively.
